findings.location: Definition, opening paragraph, sentence beginning “This is the same set that” and ending “calls R^n”.
findings.evidence: The sentence does not form a grammatical claim: after identifying R^n with functions n→R, it combines “d_1, d_2, d_infinity are metrics on it” with “calls R^n”. The explicit coordinate and norm formulas later remain readable, but this published definition contains ill-formed prose. The assigned consumer cites it for Euclidean distances and the cube diameter.
